name: Reversible Karte RK
original_name: リバーシブルカルテ RK
source:
Our guy is a doctor in a psychiatric hospital. Last night, he didn't sleep too well after watching a suspense movie where a girl got killed while having fun with her lover. It seems most of the girls in the hospital also saw this movie. Next day, a girl is found totally messed up. Who done it? Will he love someone enough to find out her secret?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家精神病院的医生。昨晚，他看了一部悬疑电影，片中一名女孩与恋人寻欢时遭人杀害，之后便没睡好。看来医院里的大多数女孩也都看过这部电影。第二天，一名女孩被发现遭到了残酷对待。是谁干的？他能否爱上某个人，并找出她的秘密？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
